grounding.states: Vancouver, WA, Tuesday Oct 13: dry, mostly cloudy, high around 64°F
grounding.from: Wunderground (Hough station) gives a high of 64°F, a mix of clouds and sun early, then cloudy in the afternoon. Precipitation chance is 1%. Timeanddate gives 64/41°F, overcast, 0% chance of precipitation. All of them expect it to stay dry.

value.answer: Which Vancouver do you mean, the one in BC or the one in Washington? For BC, Tuesday looks cloudy with a high of 14°C and a few showers starting late in the evening. For Vancouver, WA, it looks dry and mostly cloudy with a high around 64°F. Which one did you mean?
